messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Significant spike in prefix-cache miss rate for model=redwood-7b-prod in us-west-2. Miss rate went from ~2% -> ~35% starting ~2026-03-15T17:06:40Z. Autoscaler activated and latency increased. Paging #oncall and #incidents.

sara: i'm oncall, ack. moving to triage. @ben can you take infra lead? i'll collect customer impact.

ben: on it. can someone paste the hit-rate timeline and any recent infra ops around 17:00-17:10 UTC?

kai: pasting quick query and sample results from metrics (redistributed by shard):
```
# prefix_cache.hitrate (by minute)
2026-03-15T17:00:00Z 0.982
2026-03-15T17:05:00Z 0.960
2026-03-15T17:06:40Z 0.710
2026-03-15T17:07:00Z 0.650
2026-03-15T17:09:00Z 0.620
2026-03-15T17:18:00Z 0.978
```
Looks like a sharp drop starting 17:06:40, recovery ~17:18.

ben: thanks. checking control-plane ops — there was a rolling restart of the kv-controller at ~17:05 for a minor kubelet bump (ops ticket #OPS-4872). querying controller logs now.

kai: found this in controller logs around 17:05-17:07:
```
17:05:08 controller: starting graceful restart
17:05:09 ttl-sync: begin batch sync size=12000
17:05:12 ttl-sync: rpc error: code=ResourceExhausted desc="etcd request rate limit"
17:05:12 ttl-sync: partial commit 0..834
17:06:35 node-agent: key=prefix:abc ttl=0 (interpreted as expired)
17:06:40 node-agent: evict key prefix:abc
```

sara: that rpc error looks suspicious. if the controller didn't complete TTL propagation some nodes may see keys as expired and evict, triggering stampede and rewarm.

ben: hypothesis: TTL sync RPCs from controller to nodes got rate-limited during the restart -> nodes treated missing TTL metadata as expired (ttl=0) -> aggressive eviction -> cache miss storm -> downstream latency/cost spike. this matches the timing.

matt: customer-impact: two dedicated customers (acct-2314, acct-9981) reported p99 token latency jump ~120-220ms and cost-per-request ~3x for ~12m window. no 5xxs logged, but increased tail latency and token consumption. I've notified CS to reach out.

sara: immediate mitigations — what can we flip to stop stampede and rewarm traffic?

ben: doing these now:
- disable aggressive local eviction (set eviction_mode=passive)
- increase local fallback TTL to 15m so nodes don't treat missing TTL as expired
- pause the prefix-backfill job

kai: applied config patch to us-west-2 nodes at 17:11:30Z (kubectl rolling update). monitoring hit-rate.

```
# applied command
kubectl apply -f /ops/patches/eviction-passive-usw2.yaml
curl -XPOST https://config.re.redwood/v1/reload -H "Authorization: Bearer ${TOKEN}"
```

ben: hit-rate starting to recover: 17:12 -> 0.78, 17:14 -> 0.88, back to baseline by 17:18. mitigation effective.

sara: good. we should also capture full timeline, logs, and reproduce the ttl-sync failure in staging. add hypothesis to RCA thread and assign tasks.

kai: added log bundle to shared storage: https://logs.re/redwood/incidents/1768505000/ttl-sync-bundle (contains controller logs, node-agent logs, metrics snapshots). also uploaded etcd leader metrics showing elevated leader election/requests at 17:05-17:07.

ben: notes for RCA: reproduce rate-limited rpc in staging by simulating slow etcd/leader flaps; ensure controller handles partial commits without zeroing TTLs; add retries/backoff and transactional semantics so partial commits don't result in ttl=0 on nodes.

matt: CS notes: flagged affected customers and offered a short post-incident summary. billing impact being evaluated but small subset of heavy-embedding requests saw extra tokens.

olivia: i'm taking the overnight handoff for follow-up and RCA. action items for me:
- coordinate a repro in staging with ops
- draft postmortem (root cause hypothesis: TTL sync RPC partial commit due to etcd rate limit during controller restart -> nodes interpreted missing TTL metadata as expired)
- propose mitigations: transactional ttl propagation, ttl sanity check on nodes (reject ttl=0 unless explicit), telemetry alert for ttl-sync failures

sara: handoff recorded. olivia, ping me if you need runway this evening. thanks all for fast mitigation. next steps: schedule 1hr RCA tomorrow, assign owners for remediation patches and tests.

ben: added follow-up ops ticket OPS-4899 (ensure controller sync has idempotent commit and explicit ack). leaving channel but will be on-call if needed. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident resolved — prefix-cache miss spike contained and mitigated. Summary and links attached: https://docs.internal.redwood/incident/1768505000

olivia: noted. I'll add timeline and attach logs to the postmortem doc. taking over primary oncall for the next 8h.
_meta: generated for dataset: in-incident RCA coordination; cache TTL sync gap; file created per agents.md schema
